pi.title_zh: 校聘教授 · 硕士生导师
pi.bio_zh:
查汝晶，博士，校聘教授，硕士生导师，入选省高层次人才项目。安徽中医药大学人文与国际教育交流学院学科与科研秘书，中国心理卫生协会神经调控与心理健康专业委员会总干事，亚洲物质滥用研究会心理治疗专委会副秘书长，中国药物滥用防治协会行为成瘾专委会常委，安徽省社科界青年学人导师，安徽省心理卫生协会认知行为治疗专委会常委，Discover Psychology、Discover Mental Health、PLOS Mental Health 编辑，安徽省心理健康教育学会理事。

主要研究方向为中医心理物理干预，迄今以第一/通讯作者在 Molecular Psychiatry、Computers in Human Behavior、Journal of Behavioral Addictions、NeuroImage 等国际知名期刊发表 SCI/SSCI 论文 11 篇（其中中科院一区/Top 8 篇）。获安徽省社科界“优青”人才、安徽省社科界青年学术论坛百位优秀青年学者、中国科学技术大学墨子杰出青年特资津贴、国际人脑图谱学会（OHBM）Merit Abstract Award 等荣誉。

目前主持国家自然科学基金、教育部人文社会科学研究基金等多项科研项目。主要讲授《大学生心理健康教育》《网络心理学》《神经刺激技术与调控》《高级心理统计》等课程。指导研究生、本科生获国家奖学金，指导研究生获全国应用心理专业学位研究生实践技能大赛二等奖、安徽省中医药文化研究会学术年会论文一等奖、安徽省应用心理专业硕士技能竞赛特等奖，指导本科生获安徽省心理卫生协会学术年会应用心理案例赛道三等奖。
pi.bio_en:
Rujing Zha, PhD, Professor and Master's supervisor at the School of Humanities and International Education Exchange, Anhui University of Chinese Medicine; selected for the Anhui provincial high-level talent program. Academic secretary for discipline and research of the School. Secretary-General of the Neuromodulation and Mental Health Committee, Chinese Mental Health Association; Deputy Secretary-General of the Psychotherapy Committee, Asian Association for Substance Abuse Research; Standing Member of the Behavioral Addiction Committee, Chinese Association of Drug Abuse Prevention and Treatment; editorial board member of Discover Psychology, Discover Mental Health and PLOS Mental Health.

 Research focuses on TCM psychophysical intervention. As first or corresponding author, 11 SCI/SSCI papers have been published in journals including Molecular Psychiatry, Computers in Human Behavior, Journal of Behavioral Addictions and NeuroImage (8 in CAS Q1/Top). Current PI of projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China and the Ministry of Education.

 Teaches Mental Health Education for College Students, Cyberpsychology, Neurostimulation Technology and Modulation, and Advanced Psychological Statistics. Supervised students have received national scholarships and multiple national and provincial research awards.

research.q_zh: 中医经皮耳穴迷走神经刺激能否调控成瘾与 ADHD？
research.q_en: Can taVNS modulate addiction and ADHD?
research.bg_zh: 探究中医经皮耳穴迷走神经刺激结合心理物理干预，对成瘾、注意缺陷与多动障碍等精神类疾病的调控作用。
research.bg_en: Exploring taVNS combined with psychophysical interventions for addiction, ADHD and other psychiatric disorders.
research.s_zh: 为精神类疾病提供无创、可及的中西医结合干预新路径。
research.s_en: Non-invasive integrative interventions for psychiatric disorders.

research.q_zh: 中医针灸理论如何影响情绪、冲动与语言功能？
research.q_en: How does acupuncture theory affect emotion, impulse and language?
research.bg_zh: 运用实验心理学方法及神经科学技术，揭示中医针灸理论与技术对人类情绪、冲动控制、语言功能的影响机制。
research.bg_en: Using experimental psychology and neuroscience to reveal how TCM acupuncture shapes emotion, impulse control and language.
research.s_zh: 为中医理论提供现代神经科学证据，推动中西医深度对话。
research.s_en: Neuroscientific evidence for TCM theory, advancing East-West dialogue.

members.name: 查汝晶
members.research_zh: 1. 中医经皮耳穴迷走神经刺激结合心理物理干预对成瘾、ADHD 等精神类疾病的调控作用；2. 运用实验心理学与神经科学技术揭示中医针灸理论对情绪、冲动控制、语言功能的影响机制。
members.research_en: 1. taVNS combined with psychophysical intervention for addiction and ADHD; 2. Experimental psychology and neuroscience approaches to TCM acupuncture effects on emotion, impulse control and language.
